references.text: Here we see an example of an oath, and how oaths were taken seriously in biblical times, reflecting the king's dilemma in Mark 6:26.
This verse also reflects the importance of keeping promises or oaths, even when it leads to unwanted consequences, similar to the situation in Mark 6:26.
This verse parallels Mark 6:26 by showing another situation where a ruler feels compelled to fulfill an unwanted action because of a promise.
